coaching.coaching: Today's 8 km run stayed aerobic with an average HR of 149 bpm, well under your MAF ceiling of 155 bpm, and your cadence was solid at 175 spm. However, the pace of 8:33 /km is outside your target range of 7:50–8:10 /km and the peak HR of 160 bpm shows you briefly exceeded the MAF limit. Keep the effort easy and focus on staying below 155 bpm throughout the whole run.
